verdict.rationale: Docs specify that timeouts with no usable result fail 'without a charge' (return-partial policy) and describe rate-limit headers, giving some clarity on billing behavior for failed/timeout requests, but there's no explicit statement covering blocked or empty-result requests generally across all endpoints. missing for 10: explicit policy on blocked/empty-result billing for scrape/crawl/extract endpoints, independent confirmation of billing behavior, comprehensive documentation across all product surfaces.
